source_text: Psychologically, restorers frequently initiate the practice amid pre-existing emotional burdens from circumcision, such as dissatisfaction or distress (65.47%), depression (33.46%), and hopelessness (31.4%), which restoration partially alleviates for 67.03% but does not fully resolve for most.
